notes.title: PLAY IT NOW! The AaaaaAAaaaAAAaaAAAAaAAAAA!!! Remastered Demo is Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941619/dfea7c70134e472bc20811b94593e67cee3b720c.jpg[/img]

[h1]1. Play the Demo Early![/h1]
Steam Next Fest is right round the corner, we’ve released our demo early for you to jump in over the weekend!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941619/b328f388bf7b9b6b48c79319d3966d73445abf63.gif[/img]

Join us in the futuristic floating city of Boston High, and do what you do best:

[list]
[*] Jump.
[*] Hug buildings.
[*] Avoid obstacles.
[*] Wave to your fans.
[*] Flip off your haters.
[/list]
[h1]Demo and Wishlist![/h1]
1. The best way to support indie studios like us is by adding our game to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1372460/AaaaaAAaaaAAAaaAAAAaAAAAA_Remastered/]wishlist[/url]!
2. The best way to support your gaming habit is also by adding our game to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1372460/AaaaaAAaaaAAAaaAAAAaAAAAA_Remastered/]wishlist[/url]!

You can also play the demo:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1372460/AaaaaAAaaaAAAaaAAAAaAAAAA_Remastered/

[h1]How Great is the AaaaaAAaaaAAAaaAAAAaAAAAA!!! Series?[/h1]
The original won multiple awards, and we have a Guinness World Record, baby! For breaking Steam. Seriously. [url=https://discord.gg/X8wBRjmGUt]Join the Discord[/url] and ask us how. Or why. We won't lie to you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941619/92187fd29cd589c1172eb9a68e4272be9ee2a2a0.png[/img]

[h1]2. Two Things You Can Do Next[/h1]
1. [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XGLDCB2j7IU]Watch the Trailer.[/url]
2. Wishlist the Game. We already covered that, above. You know it. We know it. We're good.
2. The first person to join our [url=https://discord.gg/X8wBRjmGUt]Discord[/url] and post a true story about gargling mice in the original game will get a free gargle (street value: $0, emotional value: $inf).
2. Hello!
2. Etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941619/de1a54238f500643447968b88bb578811aaa9a2e.png[/img]

[h1]3. Facts About Falling from the CDC[/h1]
[list]
[*] One out of five falls causes a serious injury such as broken bones or a head injury.4,5
[*] Each year, 3 million older people are treated in emergency departments for fall injuries.6
[*] Over 800,000 patients a year are hospitalized because of a fall injury, most often because of a head injury or hip fracture.6
[*] Each year at least 300,000 older people are hospitalized for hip fractures.7
[*] More than 95% of hip fractures are caused by falling,8 usually by falling sideways.9
[*] Falls are the most common cause of traumatic brain injuries (TBI).10
[*] In 2015, the total medical costs for falls totaled more than $50 billion.11 Medicare and Medicaid shouldered 75% of these costs.
[/list]

TALK TO YOUR DOCTOR
[list]
[*] Ask your doctor or healthcare provider to evaluate your risk for falling and talk with them about specific things you can do.
[*] Ask your doctor or pharmacist to review your medicines to see if any might make you dizzy or sleepy. This should include prescription medicines and over-the counter medicines.
[*] Ask your doctor or healthcare provider about taking vitamin D supplements.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1372460/AaaaaAAaaaAAAaaAAAAaAAAAA_Remastered/
